Centre for Folk Performing Arts & Culture (School of Arts, Communication & Languages)

content_sections.heading: About HNBGU Guest Faculty
content_sections.text: Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University is a Central University at Srinagar (Garhwal), Uttarakhand - 246 174. The notice is issued by Prof. D.S. Kaintura, Dean, School of Arts, Communication & Languages. The Guest Faculty will teach the regular study programme of the Centre for Folk Performing Arts & Culture in the session 2026-27.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or the experience required for Guest Faculty in the Centre for Folk Performing Arts & Culture. The terms and conditions for engaging Guest Faculty are those notified in University letter no. HNBGU/ Adm. (T)/2026/1483 dated 01-08-2026. The application form attached to the notice asks candidates to give the following details. These are the form's fields, not eligibility conditions: Educational record: class, year, subject, university, total marks, percentage and division for 10th Class/Equivalent, 12th Class/Equivalent, Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree, M.Phil/Equivalent and Ph.D. NET (UGC / CSIR) or any other exam passed equivalent to NET (SLET/SET etc.). Title of the thesis, and whether the Ph.D. has been awarded as per UGC regulations 2009. Teaching experience at the under-graduation, graduation and post-graduation levels, in years and months. Post-doctoral teaching or research experience, research experience, other experience (if any) and publications. Candidates should check the official notification and University letter no. HNBGU/ Adm. (T)/2026/1483 for the discipline-specific eligibility for Guest Faculty.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is as Guest Faculty for the regular study programme of the Centre for Folk Performing Arts & Culture for the session 2026-27. The terms and conditions for engagement of Guest Faculty remain the same as notified by University letter no. HNBGU/ Adm. (T)/2026/1483 dated 01-08-2026. Conditions applicable to Guest Faculties from time to time also apply. The remuneration is not specified in the notice; it falls under the terms of the University letter mentioned above.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HNBGU Guest Faculty
content_sections.text: Applications are invited for a walk-in interview, and candidates apply first by email. The notice does not give the date, time or venue of the walk-in interview. Fill in the application form in the format attached to the notice ("Application Form for the Engagement of Guest Faculty for the Session 2026-27"). Give your name, the name of the department, course or centre (Centre for Folk Performing Arts & Culture), date of birth, category (GEN, SC, ST, OBC or PH), address for correspondence with email ID, and mobile and landline numbers. Fill in the educational qualifications and teaching or research experience sections, making sure the teaching and research periods claimed do not overlap. Complete the declaration, sign the form and write your name in block letters. Attach the other necessary supporting documents. Email the form and documents to [email protected] with a copy (cc) to [email protected] . Send the email on or before 20 November 2026, 5 pm .

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the attached format, signed by the candidate Other necessary supporting documents

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: An application not signed by the candidate is liable to be rejected. If any information is found false or incorrect, or ineligibility is detected before or after engagement as Guest Faculty, the candidature or engagement may be cancelled by the University. Periods of teaching and research experience claimed in the form must not overlap.
